name: AR_CASH_RECOS_ALL
description: This table stores the header information of the recommendations on a receipt reference

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_ID
columns.description: Recommendation Identifier

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_SOURCE
columns.description: Source from which the recommendation is generated, such as AutoMatch or Application Exception Rule.

columns.name: REMIT_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Cash remittance reference identifier used as a foreign key to AR_CASH_REMIT_REFS_ALL.REMIT_REFERENCE_ID.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Customer Identifier

columns.name: RESOLVED_MATCHING_NUMBER
columns.description: Resolved Document Number

columns.name: MATCH_RESOLVED_USING
columns.description: Receipt Match By used to do the match

columns.name: MATCH_SCORE_VALUE
columns.description: Match Score

columns.name: MATCH_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Match Reason

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_STATUS
columns.description: Recommendation Status

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates application that last updated this row. Foreign key to FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates program that last updated this row. Foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Concurrent program Who column.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: AUTOAPPLY_STATUS
columns.description: AutoApply Status

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_TYPE
columns.description: Recommendation Type

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Customer Site Use Identifier

columns.name: AUTOMATCH_RULE_ID
columns.description: Automatch Rule Identifier by which this recommendation is created

columns.name: TRANSACTION_WEIGHT
columns.description: Transaction weight for the AutoMatch rule used for the match.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SCORE
columns.description: Score for the transaction string to the remittance string

columns.name: CUSTOMER_WEIGHT
columns.description: Customer weight for the AutoMatch rule used for the match.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SCORE
columns.description: Score on customer number to the remittance customer number

columns.name: AMOUNT_WEIGHT
columns.description: Amount weight for the AutoMatch rule used for the match.

columns.name: AMOUNT_SCORE
columns.description: Score on transaction balance to the reference amount

columns.name: EXACT_AMOUNT_WEIGHT
columns.description: Amount weight when the balance amount matches the remittance amount.

columns.name: EXACT_AMOUNT_FACTOR
columns.description: Weight on the exact amount weight for the recommendation

columns.name: NET_TAX_WEIGHT
columns.description: Amount weight when the payment is net of tax.

columns.name: NET_TAX_FACTOR
columns.description: Weight on the net of tax weight for the recommendation

columns.name: NET_FREIGHT_WEIGHT
columns.description: Amount weight when the payment is net of freight.

columns.name: NET_FREIGHT_FACTOR
columns.description: Weight on the net of freight weight for the recommendation

columns.name: NET_TAX_FREIGHT_WEIGHT
columns.description: Amount weight when the payment is net of tax and freight.

columns.name: NET_TAX_FREIGHT_FACTOR
columns.description: Weight on the net of tax and freight weight for the recommendation

columns.name: NET_UNDISC_WEIGHT
columns.description: Amount weight when the payment is net of unearned discount.

columns.name: NET_UNDISC_FACTOR
columns.description: Weight on the net of unearned discount weight for the recommendation

columns.name: TAX_REMAINING
columns.description: Remaining tax for the recommendation

columns.name: FREIGHT_REMAINING
columns.description: Freight remaining in the recommendation

columns.name: UNDISC_REMAINING
columns.description: Unearned discount remaining in the recommendation

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPLIED
columns.description: Total amount applied in the recommendation

columns.name: MASTER_REQ_ID
columns.description: Request Identifier for the master automatch/autoapply program
